title: Introduction to children’s palliative care
usable_for: anchors pediatric palliative care around child and family, place of care, place of death, and bereavement choices
do_not_use_for: treating place of death as a moral ranking or universal instruction
clinical, legal, emergency, investigative, ritual, funeral-purchasing, or operational advice
publishing private scenes, child material, graphic material, or identifiable family details without consent and review
substituting public-health or institutional data for bedside testimony
erasing local law, facility policy, culture, language, disability, race, poverty, custody, or access differences
extraction_rules: extract vocabulary, setting affordances, authority structure, review gates, and source limits
separate orientation from advice, procedure, investigation, or legal interpretation
mark whether source is family-facing, professional, peer-reviewed, public-health, humanitarian, commercial, or jurisdiction-specific
route care, law, safety, crisis, and emergency questions back to appropriate local professionals or emergency services
review_notes: Card created in rev0011 for the setting-axis layer.
